design_philosophy: A mobile-first, premium experience combining the clean efficiency of tools like Notion with the warm, joyful undertones required for a kindergarten app. It uses generous spacing, large touch targets, tactile surfaces, and a soft but highly legible color palette. Avoid childish clichés; rely on emotional imagery and soft geometry instead.

typography.strategy: Soft Utility pairing. A modern, geometric but friendly sans-serif for headings to evoke approachability, paired with a highly legible, clean sans-serif for dense data reading.

spacing_and_layout.system: Tailwind standard, but shifted one step up for generosity (e.g., use p-6 instead of p-4 for cards).
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, chips, list items) MUST have a minimum height of 48px to accommodate one-handed tablet/phone use.

grids.staff_dashboard: Bento layout (Control Room Grid). Dense but clear. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
grids.parent_portal: Vertical card stack with generous spacing (gap-6) to tell a timeline story.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Max-width wrapper for the PWA on desktop/tablet to maintain mobile proportions (e.g., max-w-lg mx-auto for parent view, or full-width responsive grid for staff tablet view).

cards.classes: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-3xl shadow-sm p-6

inputs.classes: bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl p-4 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary

navigation.parent_portal: Bottom Navigation Bar. Fixed to bottom, bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-stone-100, featuring 4 icons (Home, Timeline, Menu, Gallery).
navigation.staff_portal: Top Header (sticky, glassmorphism) + floating Action Button (FAB) or bottom sheet for quick class switching.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF8C6B] text-white rounded-2xl font-semibold h-14 px-8 w-full shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 rounded-2xl font-semibold h-14 px-8 w-full hover:bg-stone-200 active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.icon_quick_action: h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-100 active:bg-stone-100

chips.style: Horizontal scrollable list for selecting students or dates without leaving the view. h-10 px-4 rounded-full border border-stone-200 snap-center.

ai_report_block.classes: bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-purple-50 border border-indigo-100 rounded-3xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden

motion.page_transitions: Slide up and fade in (opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 10 -> 0) duration 0.3s ease-out.
motion.list_stagger: Children fade in with a 0.05s stagger. Important for rendering the timeline of daily activities or student lists.
motion.micro_interactions: Tap scale (0.98) on all buttons, activity quick-entry buttons, and student cards.

empty_state.description: Abstract minimalist wooden toy blocks, perfect for empty states like 'No activities logged yet' or 'No photos uploaded'. Render as rounded images or inside cards.

testing.instructions: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, quick-action chips) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='login-staff-button', data-testid='activity-cacca-toggle', data-testid='student-select-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all React components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Install and use 'framer-motion' for all entry and state transitions.
Do NOT build generic HTML inputs. Customize Shadcn UI primitives to match the 'surfaces' and 'components' specifications (e.g., overriding rounded-md with rounded-2xl/rounded-3xl).

Build a separate layout wrapper for 'Staff' and 'Parent' views. The Parent view should look like a consumer app (bottom nav, max-width mobile column). The Staff view needs to accommodate dense tablet usage (side nav or bento grid).
Ensure the 'Daily Activities' tracking interface for staff uses large, tap-friendly buttons or bottom-sheet drawers to allow one-handed data entry (didattica, motoria, pappa, pipì, cacca).
Implement a wizard-like flow or drag-and-drop/list-selector for the 'Move students between classes' feature.
Never use generic placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com); use the provided Unsplash URLs or the AI-generated empty state.
